Author: LatiDev
Name: EchoVaultGoggles
Punchline: See who has an EchoVault profile before you say hi.
Description: Marks nearby players' nameplates with a star if they have an EchoVault (echovault.gg) profile: red for a visible profile, blue for a hidden one. Requires an EchoVault API key, set in the plugin's configuration window (accessible from the Plugin Installer).
